company.name: Reachware
company.shortDescription: Reachware is an AI-powered no-code Integration Platform (IPaaS) for mid and large enterprises to connect different data systems seamlessly.
company.description:
Reachware is a cloud integration platform that allows systems and data to connect and flow seamlessly. With Reachware, organizations can create a smarter ecosystem and automate their business processes to improve efficiency.

Reachware helps your business with:

-Facilitating cross-system collaboration for a unified business ecosystem.
-Streamlining workflows through a centralized data hub.
-Boosting efficiency by automating repetitive tasks and processes.
-Cultivating an innovative community among businesses using Reachware.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based integration platform as a service (iPaaS) that connects disparate applications and data sources to enable seamless data exchange and unified business ecosystems.
productsAndServices.name: Reachware iPaaS Platform

productsAndServices.description: A pre-built integration solution that synchronizes sales, inventory, and product data between Oracle NetSuite ERP and Foodics POS systems in real-time.
productsAndServices.name: Reachware NetSuite and Foodics Integration

productsAndServices.description: A collection of integration extensions that connect Reachware with various business systems such as loyalty programs, banking, HR, property management, and inventory management.
productsAndServices.name: Reachware Extensions Suite
